overall_reason: The system UI stack sets every role at 12px/400 in rgb(119,119,119), including the h3 'Release checklist'. The card has no type hierarchy, and its status column starts at two different x positions.

score.reason: T-LADDER fails outright: one size, one weight and one colour serve the head, the meta, the task names, the statuses and the summary. Only the 11px/500 button label differs.

findings.title: Weight steps are clear
findings.where: h3 'Release checklist' and every text role, 1440 and 375
findings.evidence: In dom-1440.json 'Release checklist' (h3), 'Due Friday · 4 tasks', 'Review copy', 'Ready', 'Test mobile', 'In review' and '2 tasks remaining' are all 12px/400, 18px line, rgb(119,119,119). On P41/01-evidence/tiles/1440-00.png the head cannot be told apart from its meta line.
findings.before: Head, meta, items, statuses and summary all 12px/400 grey
findings.after: Head at 14px/550 in the darkest ink; task names at 12px/400; meta, statuses and summary one step down (10 to 11px, lighter grey)
findings.why: With one size, weight and colour, the reader has to read every line to find the card's subject.
findings.root: a single text style applied to every element

findings.title: One size per kind of element
findings.evidence: In dom-1440.json 'Review copy' starts at x=413 and 'Test mobile' at x=420. 'Ready' starts at x=493 and 'In review' at x=511. On P41/01-evidence/tiles/1440-00.png the status words do not form a column.
findings.before: Task names and statuses placed by text width, so the left edges drift by 7 and 18px
findings.after: Put the task names on one left edge and the statuses in one right-aligned column
findings.why: Values that do not line up cannot be scanned down as a column.

findings.title: Create hierarchy with size, weight and space
findings.evidence: On P41/01-evidence/tiles/1440-00.png the summary '2 tasks remaining' and the button are centred under left-aligned rows, and the summary is the same 12px grey as the rows above.
findings.before: Centred summary in the body style
findings.after: Left-align the summary at a smaller meta size, and place the button on the same baseline at the right
findings.why: A centred line in the body style reads as one more row rather than a summary.

strengths: 'Open project' is 11px/500 on one line and does not wrap.
not_investigated: T-MEASURE: no paragraph of 3 or more lines at either width
Size floors under 12px (A11-002) and contrast belong to the sweep and the color lens; not repeated here
